## Review checklist

- [ ] This pull request adds, corrects, or revokes only the intended exact-version record.
- [ ] Subject digest and agent version identify the evaluated artifact exactly.
- [ ] Permission declaration covers Read, Draft, Change, Communicate, and Spend.
- [ ] Publisher declarations are not labeled observed or verified.
- [ ] Every `verified` status has matching inspectable `verificationEvidence`; no placeholder or synthetic proof is presented as real.
- [ ] Failures, skips, limitations, and unknowns remain visible.
- [ ] Referenced logs are public-safe and redacted.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this material under Apache-2.0 and it does not imply affiliation or endorsement.
- [ ] `node scripts/catalog.mjs validate` passes.
- [ ] `node scripts/catalog.mjs test` passes.

## What should make this evidence stale?

Describe the invalidating changes and revalidation date.

For a correction or revocation, follow `CORRECTIONS.md` and keep sensitive details out of the pull request.
